Container.Name: Downrange
Container.Overview: Downrange alpha: customizable locations, automatic multi-source direction acquisition and provider-neutral estimates, sourced trajectory geometry, jellyfish conditions, and browser push. Assumed scenarios are not confirmed flight paths. Optional Flight Club API adapter supports mission-specific simulations. Uncertain alerts are off by default. HTTPS is required for phone push. Uses the moving latest image tag for Unraid GUI updates. The application is still alpha.
Container.Description: Alpha launch visibility research and alerts. See Overview for limitations.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Change host port if 8097 is already used.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent accounts, locations, cache, and private notification keys. Back up this folder.

Config.Name: Administrator password
Config.Description: 12+ characters. Used only when the database is first created. Blank generates a password printed once in container logs.

Config.Name: HTTPS public address
Config.Description: HTTPS origin, e.g. https://launch.example.com. No path. Set this after configuring the reverse proxy; use that address to sign in.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Server timezone. Each saved viewing location has its own independent timezone.

Config.Name: Registration invitation code
Config.Description: Optional: 16+ characters. Blank disables new-account registration.

Config.Name: Push contact
Config.Description: Optional mailto:you@example.com. PUBLIC_URL is used as the push contact if this is blank.

Config.Name: Launch Library API token
Config.Description: Optional authenticated Launch Library 2 token. Blank uses free access.

Config.Name: Launch feed polling seconds
Config.Description: Minimum 600 seconds; centralized cache protects provider limits.

Config.Name: Automatic trajectory sources
Config.Description: Fetch public mission directions, linked official facts and historical ascent profiles in a separate cached worker.

Config.Name: Flight Club API key (optional)
Config.Description: Optional licensed API key for mission-specific simulations. Public-source estimates work without it. Never paste the key into a GitHub issue.
